description.p: YTDM is a desktop download manager specialized for YouTube. It brings the classic download-manager workflow — a queue you control — to video downloads.

ul.li: Download queue with pause, resume, and retry
Playlist downloads into their own folders, with per-video selection
Quality presets from 720p to best available, or audio-only M4A/MP3
Bandwidth limit, clipboard link detection, light and dark themes
Self-updating download engine (yt-dlp) that keeps working when sites change

description.p: Download only content you have the right to save.

screenshot.caption: Downloading a playlist with live per-video progress

description.p: Adds native Linux packages and cross-platform releases.
